title: Professionnalisation des services de police : le commissariat de la Tsiémé va expérimenter le projet
why_not: The article on the EU-funded Police plus project (EUR 5 million, Expertise France, three pilot central commissariats, works to end in 2026) describes renovation of cells and toilets, video surveillance and training; it says nothing on how complaints or cases are recorded or on any records system.
